Name: Adjusted Adoption Prices for Pets
Author: Sharogg
Description:
This is a tiny mod for everyone who wants to fill their farm with pets without breaking the bank. It simply adds a multiplier to all adoption prices which you can specify yourself.

The default setting is 0.2, resulting in the following prices, but you can put any multiplier you like to get the price you want.
[list]
[*]Cats: 8000
[*]Dogs: 8000
[*]Turtle: 12000
[*]Iridium Turtle: 100000
[/list]
Additionally, the price and hardwood amount of pet bowls can be modified as you want. Default is 2000g and 10 hardwood.
Also works for additional pet breeds that have been added by mods.

Installation:
Unzip the mod and paste it into Stardew Valley's Mods folder. Requires SMAPI and Content Patcher. 1.6 required (obviously).
